decisions.reason: Refunding USDC received above the $15 mint price does not change how the retained $15 is allocated among the founder, affiliate, and Small Block prize pool.
The decision applies to excess value produced by swapping an ETH payment and does not change the direct USDC wallet-mint flow.
The ETH payment method remains active and unchanged; excess-value handling is independently represented by the source refund-policy Requirement.
The refund policy does not alter which payment methods are disclosed or selectable.
The source decision concerns an ETH-to-USDC swap refund and does not affect the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow.
The source establishes treatment of excess ETH payment value, not the separate optional tipping amount or interface.
The accepted refund behavior does not explicitly require an FAQ or product-copy revision, so propagating it to FAQ content would require an additional client decision.
Excess-payment refunds do not change the condition under which the Mint Successful modal may be displayed.
The ETH refund currency and method do not alter seedless wallet provisioning or access for fiat buyers.
The refund decision does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The NFT remains an unlimited-mint ebook priced at $15; refunding swap proceeds above that price does not change the offering model or listed mint price.
Returning ETH-swap proceeds above the $15 mint price does not change the Small Block draw, eligibility, cadence, or its established funding allocation.
